signal: IntelAgree launched Saige Assist, a generative-AI tool for redlining and negotiating contracts, and is publishing fresh CLM content through mid-2026.

email.body1:
Evan, saw IntelAgree is leaning hard into Saige Assist, your generative-AI redlining and negotiation tool.

Riding an AI product push usually surfaces more in-market legal and procurement accounts than the team can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for IntelAgree off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Evan, quick follow-up for IntelAgree.

As the Saige Assist story widens the addressable base, the gap is usually that nobody knows exactly how many meetings the team must book to hit the number this quarter. The math shows up late, and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings IntelAgree needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Evan, last bit of proof for IntelAgree.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how IntelAgree's reply rate likely compares to other B2B SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Evan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Pushing a new AI product to market is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to IntelAgree either way.
